newsitem.title: CANADA: APEC finance ministers to meet in Alberta next May.
newsitem.headline: APEC finance ministers to meet in Alberta next May.

text.p: Canada will chair a meeting of APEC finance ministers in Alberta next May, Canadian Finance Minister Paul announced on Thursday.
The meeting is set for May 23-24 at Kananaskis Village, nestled in the Rockies near Calgary.
An Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit has already been set for Vancouver this November.

The Kananaskis meeting will mark the fifth year APEC finance ministers have met to discuss broad issues related to macroeconomic policies, capital flows, capital market development and infrastructure financing, a statement said.

APEC groups the United States, Canada, China and Japan along with Australia, Brunei, Chile, Hong Kong, Indonesia, Malaysia, Mexico, New Zealand, Papua New Guinea, the Philippines, Singapore, South Korea, Taiwan and Thailand.
